scientific_caveats: Internal terminal population-AF rejection and the external 500-diploid AF gate are two distinct conditioning layers.
Selection remains active through the present; this model does not estimate a selection-cessation time.
Recipient nonloss and target-AF attainment condition on successful introgression and cannot estimate unconditional sweep prevalence.
SLiM Q=5 is an approximation and is frozen for every phase.
No Gamma-SMC or TMRCA statistic enters planning, gating, or freezing.
